snippet.title: Midwinter Fan Remaster — Early Access Release - Is Here
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD THE Early Early Access BUILD (Windows):
https://midwinter-remaster.titanium-helix.com/download

JOIN THE DISCORD (bug reports + feedback):
https://discord.gg/BPUUUFJs2J

A solo-developed fan remaster of Mike Singleton's 1989 classic Midwinter — retro gameplay, modern graphics, rebuilt from the original in Unreal Engine 5.

TIPS FOR NEW PLAYERS
• Play the tutorial first: Arctic Survival School
• Two scenario starts are available — one easy, one brutal
• For the easy start: pick the Curated Start under Normal, then ski northwest to Barefoot Valley Settlement
• The Frostopedia is your online manual
• Tester cheat mode: toggle with Ctrl+F10
• Windows SmartScreen warning: click "More info" then "Run anyway" (the build is unsigned for now)

Found a bug? Tell us on Discord.

Steam Early Access: September 2, 2026

website:  https://midwinter-remaster.titanium-helix.com
